subject: JUSTIFIED clause
notes: kb/Work PB737 (adjudication). THE RULE: 'When the receiving data item is described with the JUSTIFIED clause and the sending operand is larger than the receiving data item, the leftmost character positions or boolean positions of the sending operand shall be truncated' (cite.py --check 13.18.32.4 => OK 1)). ONE MECHANISM, ONE PLACE: every character store into an alphanumeric/alphabetic/national receiver routes through RuntimeApi.StrStoreAligned (MOVE, STRING, the INVOKE formal copy-back, ACCEPT temporal - kb/Work PB139's one-rule-one-place extraction of six hand-rolled ternaries), a boolean receiver through StrStoreBoolean, and BOTH end at CobolString.Store, whose justifiedRight arm is 'value.Length > width ? value[^width..]' - the RIGHTMOST width positions kept, i.e. the LEFTMOST truncated, which is the rule read literally. THE RULE NAMES TWO POSITION KINDS AND FOUR USAGES, AND EACH WAS MEASURED RATHER THAN INFERRED FROM THE ALPHANUMERIC ARM. Sending five positions into three: PIC X(3) JUSTIFIED gets 'CDE' (pb339_into_current_record leg B, whose sender is a 5-byte current record); PIC A(3) JUSTIFIED gets 'CDE'; PIC N(3) JUSTIFIED gets national CDE; PIC 1(3) JUSTIFIED and USAGE BIT PIC 1(3) JUSTIFIED both get '001' - the boolean-position half of the rule's own wording, and the USAGE BIT carrier answers the same way as the DISPLAY carrier because GR1 truncates POSITIONS, not bytes. Right truncation (the non-JUSTIFIED 14.6.8.5/14.6.8.6 rule) would give ABC/ABC/ABC/110/110, so every leg discriminates. JUSTIFIED is legal on exactly these categories by 13.18.32.3 SR3 (alphabetic, alphanumeric, boolean, national), so the four measured usages are the rule's whole domain; a numeric or edited receiver cannot carry the clause. New test conformance-test:NationalBooleanDataTests.JustifiedRight_SenderLarger_TruncatesLeftmostAcrossUsages carries the national/alphabetic/boolean/bit legs, which were implemented but unevidenced before this adjudication; the DISPLAY-alphanumeric leg is pb339_into_current_record leg B, corroborated by the ACCEPT temporal receiver. A reference-modified receiver stays exempt by 8.4.3.3.4 GR6 and a screen item's JUSTIFIED is a separate clause (13.18.32 in ScreenFacility's staged band), neither of which is this rule. EDITION-INVARIANCE WAS DERIVED, NOT ASSUMED: no docs/VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE.md row touches 13.18.32. The national and boolean legs are written at 2002 because PIC N and PIC 1 are themselves 2002+ language elements, not because the rule changes. || EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED: 1985 . 2002 . 2014 . 2023
